wiki.title: James Rosapepe
wiki.extract: James Carew Rosapepe (born May 20, 1951) is an American politician and diplomat serving as a member of the Maryland Senate since 2007, representing District 21. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 1987 to 1997, and was the United States Ambassador to Romania from 1998 to 2001.
